# FreeExpenseTracker.com — LLM Discovery Guide

> FreeExpenseTracker.com is a privacy-first, 100% free web application and personal finance template library designed for everyday budgeting, debt payoff modeling, and systematic savings challenges.

## Canonical Domain
https://freexpensetracker.com/

## Overview & Architecture
- **Client-Side Storage**: User transaction ledgers, income simulations, and budget allocations run entirely within client-side browser memory (`localStorage`). No transaction rows, account numbers, or bank credentials are ever transmitted to or stored on external database servers.
- **Zero Logins or Required Accounts**: Every tool, live planner, and spreadsheet download is completely accessible without registration, email capture, or recurring subscriptions.
- **Google Analytics (GA4)**: Standard privacy-preserving site usage metrics (page views, interactions, device/browser metadata) are collected under measurement ID `G-XR6MG2FM4M`. No financial records, personal identification, or transaction dollar amounts are ever dispatched to analytics.

## Core Application Features
1. **Live Interactive Expense Tracker**:
   - Real-time cashflow dashboard with dynamic category allocation charts.
   - Quick expense logging with preset chips and instant ledger persistence.
   - Client-side CSV and Excel (.xlsx) export capabilities.
2. **Universal Statement & Receipt Importer**:
   - In-browser optical character recognition (OCR) powered by client-side WebAssembly/Web Workers (`tesseract.js`) for receipt photos and mobile payment screenshots.
   - Tabular statement parsing (`csv`, `xlsx`, and digital PDF statements via `pdfjs-dist`).
   - Automated category matching and duplicate record identification.
3. **Debt Payoff Engine**:
   - Interactive Debt Snowball (lowest balance first) and Debt Avalanche (highest interest rate first) accelerated debt reduction models.
   - Side-by-side payoff timelines, total interest savings calculations, and custom extra-payment sliders.
4. **Target & Budget Planning**:
   - 50/30/20 budget allocation model (Needs, Wants, Savings).
   - Milestone savings goal visualizer with monthly contribution planning.
